settings-campus-card.ts (pure):
```ts
export type SettingsCampusInput = { schoolVerified: boolean; schoolSystem: "iu"|"purdue"|null; campusId: string|null; campusConfirmed: boolean; campusChangeAvailableAt: string|null; onboarded: boolean };
export type SettingsCampusView = { mode: "unverified"|"pick"|"confirm"|"set"; options: Array<{ id: string; label: string }>; value: string; sub: string|null; locked: boolean; note: string|null };
export function settingsCampusCardView(i: SettingsCampusInput, now?: number): SettingsCampusView;
export function nextAvailableAfterWrite(onboarded: boolean, now?: number): string|null; // onboarded ? ISO(now + 30d) : null
```
- mode: !schoolVerified || !schoolSystem → unverified; !campusId → pick; !campusConfirmed → confirm; else set.
- options = campusesForSystem(system) mapped to label = isOpen ? shortName : `${shortName} — not open yet`.
- value = campusId ?? "". sub = campusPickerSub(row, system) for the current value, else null.
- locked = !!campusChangeAvailableAt && Date.parse(it) > now. note = locked ? campusChangeTooSoonCopy(campusChangeAvailableAt) : null (the helper at profile-campus-write.ts:158 → "You can change your campus again on {Month D}.").

SettingsClient.tsx CampusCard (:490-608, replace):
- Copy under the title: "Your campus community: its clubs, events and map. Indianapolis is one community for IU and Purdue students." Remove "Not verified — change it any time." and "Leave it unset to see everything across IU." (:549-554).
- mode unverified: "Verify your school email to pick your campus." plus Link "Verify now →" to /auth/school-email. No select.
- Otherwise a select: when value is "", the first option is `<option value="" disabled>Pick your campus</option>`. Then the options. There is NO 'Not set' option (delete :577-586's IU_CAMPUSES list and the import at :12). Show sub under the select. `disabled={saving || locked}`. When locked, show note.
- mode confirm: a callout above the select. Title "Confirm your campus", body "Is {shortName} still right?", buttons "Yes" (PATCH {campus_id: value}) and "Change" (focuses the select).
- Writes: vibeRequest("/api/me/profile", {method:"PATCH", json:{campus_id: next}, quiet:true, failure:"Couldn't save your campus. Try again."}), replacing the raw fetch with `school` at :515-523.
  * ok → value=next, confirmed=true, "Saved ✓", availableAt = nextAvailableAfterWrite(onboarded) (so the lock note appears immediately).
  * Failure → revert the select. Error text: r.code==="campus_change_too_soon" && body availableAt → campusChangeTooSoonCopy(availableAt); else r.error ?? r.message. A 401 or terms error shows r.message.
- The section keeps id="campus" (:538) for the /settings#campus deep link.

CampusTourCard copy (:150-151) → "Walk through vibe again with Otto. Takes about a minute." (the phone campus leg is now the last leg; see openQuestions #7). Logic unchanged.

Sign-out and deletion clear the onboarding draft: import { clearDraft } from "@/lib/onboarding/draft" and call clearDraft() with NO id (removes every vibe_onb_draft_v1:* key on this origin; a shared device is the case that matters):
- SignOutCard.onSignOut: after `if (!r.ok) {...return}` (:931-935) and before `window.location.href = "/auth/login"` (:937).
- DangerZone.onDelete: after a successful DELETE /api/me, before `window.location.href = "/"` (:1001).
- accept-terms-form.tsx onSignOut: after the try/catch around the logout fetch (:64-72) and before `window.location.href = "/auth/login"` (:74). It runs whether or not the fetch succeeded, matching the best-effort logout there.
Not in this batch (listed so nobody assumes they're covered): the verify-school/page.tsx:235 and EmailLinkProblem.tsx:75 signOut calls (pre-onboarding screens; the key is per user id, low risk) and the server deletion at api/me/route.ts:129 (it can't reach localStorage).
